bedroomNote.claim: Plan 4b recorded that 6.webp and 11.webp 'between them show the window wall and the bed-head wall to be perpendicular', and that F.bed's 2.1 m headboard buries ~0.45 m of the 1.3 m window.
bedroomNote.headboardArithmetic: CONFIRMED and unfixable on this wall. The south wall is 3.1 m long. F.bed draws its headboard w + 0.5 = 2.1 m wide, and the window is 1.3 m. 2.1 + 1.3 = 3.4 > 3.1, so a bed with its head on that wall CANNOT clear that window at any x.
bedroomNote.perpendicularArrangement: TRIED AND REJECTED on evidence. The bedroom's only two exterior walls are west (x=0) and south (z=6.65), so 'perpendicular' means bed head west. A bed with its head at the west wall face (x 0.07) and its 2.05 m length running east occupies x 0.195-2.245, and camera 11 stands at (1.35, 3.9) -- inside it at every z that also clears the window bench. Built and run: the validator returned 'photo spot inside furniture' for 6.webp and a bed z that avoids camera 11 collides with the window bench. Task 2's own rule forbids moving a camera to rescue a layout.
